curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the keep-right rule and its exceptions, then the basic speed law, minimum limits, the ten, thirty and fifty-five default limits, school and work zones, the passing allowance and why speed raises crash risk.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule, with contrast cards for the three default limits and for the passing allowance versus the posted maximum.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a road type or situation and asking for the speed rule that applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the extra fines at twenty over, revocation over one hundred, the emergency vehicle surcharge, and the hazards, road shapes, loose surfaces and bridges that call for slower speeds.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each penalty and slow-down situation, with a contrast card for extra fines versus revocation.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a speeding driver faces and where a driver must reduce speed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the one hundred foot signal rule, daylight hand signals, staying within one lane, safe lane changes with a head check, and blind spots including other drivers'.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule, with a contrast card for daytime versus night hand signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when and how to signal and how to change lanes safely.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through preparing for turns, waiting with wheels straight, left turns on green, left and right turn lanes, multiple turn lanes, and the rules for turning right or left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each turning rule, with contrast cards for left versus right turn finishing lanes and right versus left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an intersection and asking which turn is allowed and where it should finish.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover how to approach, enter and drive a roundabout, emergency vehicles and large vehicles in roundabouts, then the J-turn sequence and crossing or turning onto rural divided highways.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule, with contrast cards for the entry yield versus the large-vehicle yield and crossing versus turning left onto a divided highway.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on roundabout and J-turn scenarios asking who yields and what to do next.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when a U-turn is allowed or banned, using the farthest lane and shoulder, slow drivers on one-lane roads, and the right-lane rule with its exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each U-turn and lane rule, with a contrast card for the one-lane versus multi-lane rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking whether a described U-turn or left-lane use is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through safe passing: preparation, signals and return, the one hundred foot rules, yellow lines, the seven hundred foot sight rule, being passed, passing on the right, and backing on freeways and from driveways.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each passing and backing rule, with contrast cards for the two one hundred foot rules and single versus double yellow lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road and a pass and asking whether it is legal.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec05-m01..sec05-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Traffic laws: speed, signaling, lanes, turns, roundabouts, J-turns, U-turns and passing
Traffic law confusables and continuation facts

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
